text.autoconfig.globalserverconfig.title: Global Server Config Settings
text.autoconfig.globalserverconfig.optio: Redirect server configs to config/serverconfig/. Changes require game restart.
Copy existing saves/<world>/serverconfig/*.toml to config/serverconfig/ on world start.
Subdirectory under config/ to store globalized server configs. Changes require game restart.
These mods' server configs stay per-world. Changes require game restart.
